en.headline: Sushi Zanmai opens first Hong Kong restaurant in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The Japanese chain's outlet on Humphreys Avenue began service on 24 November with 82 seats, offering bluefin tuna nigiri and a limited promotion of three cuts until 23 December.
body: Japanese sushi operator Kiyomura Corporation opened its first Hong Kong restaurant, Sushi Zanmai Hong Kong Main Store, on 24 November in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The outlet occupies the ground floor of One Humphreys at 1-2A Humphreys Avenue, a short walk from Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station Exit A2. It has 82 seats including counter, table and private room places, and planned hours of 11am to midnight.

The company said the opening is its first in China and Asia, following a Los Angeles store in 2025. On opening day staff demonstrated the cutting of a large bluefin tuna. From 24 November to 23 December, the first 300 dine-in customers each day who order at least one food item receive a plate with one piece each of otoro, chutoro and akami bluefin cuts.
Individual bluefin pieces were listed at about HK$20 for the leaner cut and HK$40 for fatty belly in early reports, with other nigiri options such as salmon and squid at lower prices.

zh.headline: 壽司三昧尖沙咀開設香港首店
zh.dek: 日本連鎖店於11月24日在堪富利士道開始營業，設82個座位，並推出至12月23日的藍鰭吞拿三貫推廣。
body: 日本壽司營運商喜代村株式會社於11月24日在尖沙咀開設香港首間「壽司三昧」餐廳。
店舖位於堪富利士道1至2A號One Humphreys地下，距離尖沙咀港鐵站A2出口約一分鐘路程。全店共82個座位，包括吧枱、餐桌及私人房間，營業時間暫定為上午11時至午夜12時。
公司表示這是品牌在中國及亞洲的首家分店，繼2025年洛杉磯店之後的海外拓展。開業當天有大型藍鰭吞拿切割示範。由11月24日至12月23日，每日最先300位堂食並點選至少一款食品的顧客，可獲贈大拖、中拖及赤身各一貫的藍鰭吞拿拼盤。
早前報道指藍鰭吞拿單貫約20港元（較瘦部分）及40港元（肥拖），三文魚及魷魚等其他握壽司價格較低。
